audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer names abilities Aurora does not have: 'Passage', 'Vile Bolt', 'her hex-flask slow field', and an ultimate that 'spreads a delayed detonation'. Her real kit is Spirit Abjuration (P), Twofold Hex (Q), Across the Veil (W), The Weirding (E), Between Worlds (R).
audit.why: The kit file is authority on names, and the packet's defect list flags that the page never names one of her abilities. None of the invented names map onto a real spell, and the 'delayed detonation' ultimate is a different champion's mechanic entirely — Between Worlds is a shockwave plus a slow field she can teleport across.
audit.corrected: spikes[0], spikes[1], early, mid, late, whys[2], whys[3], wants.you[2] and all three wants.foe rewritten onto the real kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven rows disagreed. Content read Akali, Akali, Aurora, Aurora, Akali, Akali, Akali; full read Aurora, Aurora, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches the content layer exactly and the shape is right: Aurora cannot leap until level 2 and pays 80 mana on a 22s timer, so Akali contests early; Aurora owns 3-5 with Twofold Hex at 900 range plus two disengages; Akali retakes it from 6 and the first item at 51.51% over 1623 games.
audit.corrected: All seven full-layer rows flipped onto the content/packet chart as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike was described as her strongest poke-and-disengage window via a detonation that does not exist.
audit.why: Between Worlds is 140s at rank 1, only 250 range, and its value is the slow field she can teleport across — it is an escape hatch as much as an engage, which changes whether you respect her 6 at all.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] rewritten with the real mechanic and cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: No numbers; the page tracked only a vague 'hop + stealth escape'.
audit.why: Across the Veil is 22/21/20/19/18 and The Weirding 15/14/13/12/11. She has TWO disengages, not one, and the page only ever counted one — that is why 'she is killable only while it is down' was misleading.
audit.corrected: Both cooldowns now named in breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and breakdown.carry.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal note despite Spirit Abjuration healing her off every spell and attack that damages you.
audit.why: missingInteractions flagged needs-antiheal; enemy P text: exorcised spirits 'follow Aurora around and heal her'. Extended trades where you chip her feed that heal.
audit.corrected: Ignite named in the itemization line.

edits.before: You can bully Aurora early since her kit isn't fully online until she has mana and cooldowns to kite freely, so pressuring her before she has room to dash away with Passage keeps the lane close to even in your favor.
edits.after: You can bully Aurora early: Across the Veil is not up at level 1 and costs 80 mana on a 22s timer, so before she can leap away her only answer to a walk-up is The Weirding's backward hop. Force those trades.

edits.before: Aurora's dash-and-poke kiting kit takes over through levels 3-6 — she out-trades you from range and her ultimate punishes any extended engage, so you have to be patient and pick single-target dive windows instead of chasing.
edits.after: Aurora takes over through levels 3-5 — Twofold Hex pokes from 900 and The Weirding slows you while hopping her out, so an extended chase only feeds her spirit heal. Be patient and open when both are down.

edits.before: Once you're itemized, your burst and stealth close the distance her Passage dash usually buys her, letting your reset-chain combo finish kills before she can escape — this is where the matchup swings back to you.
edits.after: Once you're itemized your burst closes the distance Across the Veil buys her — she has one leap on 22s and one hop on 15s, so open when both are spent and the reset chain finishes before she can answer.

notes: Deliberately did NOT write that Twilight Shroud reveals Aurora out of Across the Veil's invisibility. Akali's kit file carries a 'revealsStealth' derived flag, but Riot's own W text only says the shroud reveals AKALI when she attacks from inside it — the flag contradicts the description, so per the brief I trusted the description and left the claim out. Same caution applied to Akali vs Akshan, where the missing-interactions file asserts that reveal directly; I phrased that one as the shroud stripping his camouflage advantage rather than as a hard reveal, but it is worth a human check. Also: the full layer calls Aurora 'his'/'he' in tldr, winCon, dosFull and dontsFull — champion-wide phrasing, left alone.
